engine_scope: old baseline and separate candidate compiler capability; identical candidate compiler is explicitly a parity preparation, not an upgrade measurement

protocol.selection: ordinary complete pinned DB selection; same fixed model; proofs are checked separately from profitability
protocol.consumption: all returned vector words read inside timer using U32 weighted checksum; scalar U32 value read directly; common consumer overhead included

boundaries.captured-js-owned: captured typed inputs, owned Array output; scalar uses captured-js-value
boundaries.captured-wasm-owned: runtime capture/packing/scheduling/owned output; scalar uses captured-wasm-value
boundaries.resident-wasm-destination: setup outside timer; borrowed vector output into dedicated packed destination; scalar uses resident-wasm-scalar
boundaries.instrumented-full-gpu-request: capture, upload, dispatch, full owned readback; actual backend and device counters per call
boundaries.resident-gpu-input-owned-readback: input upload and pipeline setup excluded; each run dispatches and returns full owned readback; supported only with real prepared session API

split_policy: fresh fit: train affine/compaction/scan at64,8192; all512cells held out; all other families wholly held out. Prior Engine39 families/controls have been observed and remain exploratory. Four new composition/gather families disjoint from this fit, not an independent confirmation of seen workloads.
startup_scope: Per-bundle import/runtime initialization after integrity prefetch; warm file/network caches, not fresh-process cold start. First-call validation durations and prepared input-upload setup remain separate from kernel timings.
incremental_scope: pure fixed overwrite batch with unique cadence indices; dense payload ABI identical; no maintained-state or stateful proof authority; full recompute control explicit
native_scope: Ink emitted C destination vs expert Rust destination; separate emitted Ink Rust owned Vec vs expert Rust owned Vec. Resident/captured ingress priced explicitly; no Rust output buffer reuse claimed

baseline.ingress: two Vec input copies per emitted call from resident/captured public words; exact emitted body may copy internally
baseline.result: fresh emitted Vec result; JS copies full result to owned Array and frees Vec inside each invocation
baseline.native: result Vec retained until full-word consumer then bench_reset drops; no output destination reuse claimed
baseline.trusted: public numeric/list method extraction, wrapper/toolchain/ABI; exact method body bytes are unchanged, not a semantic refinement proof

captured-js-owned.ingress: capture both public lists per call

resident-wasm-destination.ingress: resident packed input pointers and scalars, setup excluded
resident-wasm-destination.result: caller destination, borrowed until next call

captured-wasm-owned.ingress: capture and pack both public lists per call

resident-rust-wasm-owned-readback.ingress: resident public words; emitted Ink Rust constructs two Vec inputs per call; expert borrows words
resident-rust-wasm-owned-readback.result: fresh Vec, full Array readback and Vec release included

captured-rust-wasm-owned.ingress: capture and upload both public lists per call; emitted Ink Rust additionally constructs two Vec inputs
captured-rust-wasm-owned.result: fresh Vec, full Array readback and Vec release included

resident-native-destination.result: reused destination; full-word consumption and arena reset inside timer

captured-native-destination.ingress: copy both public input arrays inside timer
captured-native-destination.result: reused destination; full-word consumption and arena reset inside timer

resident-native-owned.ingress: resident public input pointers; emitted Ink Rust constructs two Vec inputs; expert borrows
resident-native-owned.result: fresh Vec; full-word consumption and Vec drop inside timer

captured-native-owned.ingress: copy both public arrays inside timer; emitted Ink Rust additionally constructs two Vec inputs
captured-native-owned.result: fresh Vec; full-word consumption and Vec drop inside timer

instrumented-full-gpu-request.ingress: capture, pack and upload each complete request
instrumented-full-gpu-request.result: full owned readback; actual counters from executed device route

resident-gpu-input-owned-readback.result: each call dispatches and returns full owned readback; zero per-run upload required
